fact: The mission was told that the contract with the SIMBA software publisher was signed on 2 September 2024 after nearly two years of negotiation, and that the publisher and project AMOA support would address residual faults and roll the software out to line ministries.
title: Projet de Gouvernance Numérique du Secteur Public (PGNSP) P174620, mission d'appui à la mise en oeuvre et revue à mi-parcours, 30 septembre - 4 octobre 2024
